summary: Iter 54: Parcel Rating (FedEx+UPS OAuth + sample fallback) and SPS Commerce EDI 204/990/214/210/856 fully tested. 13/13 backend pytest tests pass and full frontend flow on /carrier-integrations works end-to-end. Sample mode is correctly the default (no creds wired). Connect endpoints flip provider.connected=true but subsequent live upstream calls 401 and gracefully fall back to sample as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: parcel_rating.py:56 — ZIP delta approximation (abs(int(z1)-int(z2))*0.35) is only used when centroid missing. For test ZIPs 30301->85001 both are in ZIP_CENTROIDS, so distance 1594mi is haversine — OK.

edi_sps.py:230 _ensure_seed — called on both 204 and 856 GETs. Safe because count_documents check gates the insert_many. Non-critical: on the very first call in an empty DB this issues 2 sequential inserts (fine at current data volume).

edi_sps.py:302 _persist_outbound — record dict is inserted, but return also carries an in-memory copy that still has _id after insert_one mutates the dict. Code correctly calls record.pop('_id', None) before returning. Note: the initial dict(record) copy is inserted, and _id is set on the copy — so record itself remains clean; the pop is harmless. Code is correct.
parcel_rating.py:344 quote — records to Mongo via insert_one(dict(record)); avoids leaking _id back to caller since the response dict is separate. OK.
Two 401 console errors observed on page load — these are from an unrelated global fetch (not from any /parcel/ or /edi/ endpoint) and do not affect the iter-54 flows. Non-blocking.
